items.title: artex-ko
items.description: ARTEX 한국어판 · AI 자율 침투 테스트 프레임워크 현지화 (upstream: Autumn-27/ARTEX, AGPL-3.0)
items.summary: The ARTEX 한국어판 · AI 자율 침투 테스트 프레임워크 현지화 project, referred to as 'artex-ko', is an autonomous AI penetration testing framework localization project. It was launched on October 3, 2026, and is available on GitHub under the AGPL-3.0 license. The project aims to localize a Chinese AI-based autonomous penetration testing tool into Korean, which has raised concerns about the potential for misuse by less knowledgeable users or malicious actors, despite its intended defensive and research purposes. The project includes additional detection rules for Sigma and Suricata that were not present in the original Chinese version.

items.title: leviathan
items.description: Deep memory for agents over large datasets. Leviathan is a single static binary that turns your records (JSONL, JSON, CSV/TSV, SQLite, or anything a database CLI can export) into a ranked full-text index.
items.summary: Leviathan is a single static binary that converts various data formats into a ranked full-text index, enabling agents to handle temporal queries and multi-hop reasoning more effectively. In 2026, AI agent memory is a dedicated architectural component separate from the model’s context window, allowing agents to retain information across sessions and improving task success by up to 20.9% on in-domain benchmarks and 19.2% on out-of-domain ones. Mem0 and Shaped are two tools in this space, with Mem0 focusing on storing specific user facts and Shaped excelling at retrieval over large datasets.

items.title: agentcraft

It installs lightweight hooks into agent CLIs to report session events to a server, rendering them in a browser-based game UI. On GitHub, AgentCraft is described as a Spigot plugin for Minecraft that spawns intelligent NPC agents backed by Claude, capable of autonomous navigation and various tasks. AgentCraft by Ido Salomon is a tool for agent orchestration inspired by real-time strategy games, featuring a Warcraft 3 themed interface with heroes, buildings, and real-time task management.

The skill is free, MIT-licensed, and runs inside Claude Code.

items.description: Turn one illustration into an animated 2D mesh avatar with a coding agent and a local editor
items.summary: Mesh Avatar Studio transforms a single static illustration into an animated 2D mesh avatar that blinks, talks, turns its head, breathes, and sways its hair. The process involves a coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) that prepares the avatar from your image, and a local editor where you fine-tune it with a live preview. The coding agent follows a guide to check coordinates, place the rig, cut the image into layers, and review the avatar in fixed poses. The project is saved in a non-committed directory. Best results come from a front-facing, head-and-shoulders PNG with a transparent background. The software requires Node.js 22.17+.

items.title: ai-newtab
items.description: Claude generates a daily new tab page based on your browser history.
items.summary: The sources indicate that ai-newtab, or Claude, generates a daily new tab page based on your browser history. The extension operates directly through a Claude Managed Agents session without an intermediary server, utilizing custom tools that require `chrome.history` and `chrome.tabs`. It manages browser tabs autonomously, with a safety classifier reviewing actions in real time to block malicious actions and allow legitimate tasks. The extension also supports scheduling tasks and automations at various frequencies, including daily, and features cross-surface history that saves side panel conversations in your account history.

items.title: SCM
items.description: Deep AI search for every photo and every frame of video in any folder on macOS
items.summary: SCM is a deep AI search tool for macOS that performs local-first indexing of every photo and every frame of video in any folder, enabling offline search without uploading personal media to the cloud. It uses CLIP ViT-L/14@336 model for local inference and offers five search modes: Files, Scenes, OCR, Dialogue, and an optional local LLMs 'Ask' chat. Unlike Apple Photos, SCM targets folders, external-drive archives, and other collections outside the Photos library.

The GitHub repository details two types of projects: passthrough mods linking two games together and Rust rewrites rebuilding a game's engine in Rust. The Althera Games blog emphasizes the practical use of AI agents in game development, particularly in UE5 workflows, asset pipelines, and QA processes. items.summary: Hermes Desktop is a native desktop application for the Hermes Agent, an open-source AI agent developed by Nous Research. It provides a graphical interface for managing the agent and runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux. The application requires a running Hermes Agent instance accessible via SSH to connect. Hermes Desktop is designed to give the agent local access to files, terminals, and system resources, functioning as a standalone application without relying on cloud intermediaries. The project was inspired by the Dev Challenges Hermes Agent hackathon, aiming to make open-source AI agent tooling accessible and visually intuitive.

It can be interacted with via chat or voice mode, supporting speech-to-text and text-to-speech through various providers. Hermes Agent is designed to run on your server, remember what it learns, and get more capable over time. items.title: pi-pocket
items.description: A durable, multiplayer, mobile-first web app for Pi agents, built on Pi Durable
items.summary: Pi Durable is an experimental framework from Arendelle, released alongside Pi 1.0, for building applications around agent conversations that need to survive restarts. It treats conversations as durable state, allowing them to be checkpointed, resumed after a crash, and run multiple at once. Pi Durable is a standalone framework meant for applications that need agent conversations to persist across process restarts, supporting multiple simultaneous conversations, each with its own model, tool set, instructions, and working directory. It is separate from the main Pi package and is described as a new substrate for building long-running agentic applications.

items.title: bops

items.summary: Bops is a team of AI bots that run your business operations, each with its own computer, email, and phone number. Each bot has its own cloud computer with four screens, and you can watch any screen live or take over. Bots can work in your Mac's apps through Codex computer use, with your rules for which apps they may use. You can chat with your bots like teammates, and they do the work on their own cloud computers: inbox, pipeline, invoices, reports. Texts and calls: each workspace's main bot has a phone number (AgentPhone). Text it like a person (tapbacks, threads, reminders by text), or call it and talk to it live (GPT-Live over SIP). Slack, Telegram and Discord: add a bot like a teammate, and it answers where you asked. Calls in the app: talk to any bot by voice, and it can start tasks while you talk. Routines and watches: scheduled tasks and reminders, and screens a bot keeps an eye on for you.

items.title: RoboHarness
items.description: A robotic harness that gives LLM agents a visual-geometric control panel so that they can directly understand and invoke embodied tasks.
items.summary: RoboHarness is a system that wraps independently developed control systems, including VLA, RL policies, and TAMP, as callable agentic skills. It dynamically selects policies according to the task and environment, reroutes when a policy fails or execution conditions change, and generates bridge trajectories when the state distributions of adjacent policies are incompatible. RoboHarness is policy-agnostic by design, meaning its underlying policies need not share a model architecture, action space, or other constraints. It also includes self-evolution skills that adapt RoboHarness using online execution evidence through four types of updates, including policy adaptation and harness refinement.

The system also automatically generates character profiles and handles character appearance changes over time. While there was an issue with a character's appearance change between scenes, the overall quality of the generated drama was deemed high, with natural character performances and consistent scene layouts. The system's structured, self-correcting generation method aims to better maintain the drama's pacing, narrative coherence, and production quality.

items.title: lithos-metal
items.description: Lithos Metal: high-performance LLM inference kernels and serving for Apple silicon.
items.summary: lithos-metal is a fully open-source inference engine for Apple silicon that generates Metal megakernels to provide low-latency LLM inference. It combines layer-wise mixer megakernels, GPU-resident generation control, and DSpark speculative decoding to reduce execution overhead. It serves Qwen3.8-27B at more than 200 tokens per second per user on M5 Max chips, achieving approximately 1.8–2× the throughput of MLX and Ollama at short contexts and more than 2× that of vLLM-Metal. The engine is available on GitHub under the Apache 2.0 license.

items.title: podcast-to-article
items.description: 把多人对谈播客的逐字稿整理成可发布长文的 Agent Skill：换轴成文、人名校准、精简三分之一、去 AI 味自检。An agent skill that turns podcast transcripts into publishable articles.
items.summary: The GitHub repository "podcast-to-article" describes an agent skill that turns podcast transcripts into publishable articles by changing the axis from speaker and time to topic and judgment. It follows three rules: removing speaker's scaffolding, retaining factual granularity, and keeping the original speaker's tone. The tool supports SRT, VTT, and MD/TXT formats and includes a seven-step process: cleaning the transcript, extracting key points, defining the main line, reframing the content with original text, synchronizing names, simplifying, and self-checking. The process aims to retain direct quotes and reduce the text by a third while ensuring the article reads naturally without AI traces.

items.title: ste-zh

items.summary: According to the sources, ASD-STE100 is a set of principles for Simplified Technical English used to make technical documents clearer and more understandable. It emphasizes using one word per meaning, active voice, and clear, concise instructions. Karpathy found that applying these principles to AI-generated responses made them clearer. The sources also mention that ASD-STE100 can be adapted to different contexts, with a strict mode for high-risk instructions and a more flexible mode for general explanations. Additionally, the sources suggest that visual aids like diagrams and interactive web pages can further enhance understanding beyond text.

items.title: openchart

The agents can work with charts, indicators, and alerts, and custom indicators and alert conditions are written in Tea, a programming language built for the markets. OpenAlice, on the other hand, is a local trading workspace designed to turn coding agents into trading agents by giving them a workspace, files, issues, market tools, and approval-gated trading primitives. It aims to organize trading research into a software development project-like structure.

items.title: absent-author
items.description: Research and writing can be automated. Authorship cannot. Evidence list + agent skills for spotting AI-produced papers no human stood behind.
items.summary: According to the sources, AI tools cannot be authors because they cannot take responsibility for the submitted work or manage copyright and license agreements. The International Committee of Medical Journal Editors (ICMJE) and the Committee on Publication Ethics (COPE) state that AI tools cannot be listed as authors. Human authors remain fully accountable for the content, including any errors introduced by AI, and must disclose the substantive use of AI in research writing. AI can assist with research writing but must remain outside the boundaries of authorship and be acknowledged and cited.
